page: 27 (Statement of Net Position (Unaudited), printed p. 26); 13 (MD&A debt paragraph); 3 and 32 (unaudited disclaimer / basis of presentation)
quote: STATEMENT OF NET POSITION (UNAUDITED), CAMPUS 2024 (in thousands of dollars): 'Commercial paper 20,456'; 'Current portion of long-term debt 682,638'; 'Long-term debt 5,545,228'. MD&A: 'Total debt outstanding was $6,248 million at the end of 2024 compared to $6,238 million at the end of 2023.' Disclaimer: 'The accompanying financial information has been prepared by management of the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and is unaudited.'
arithmetic: Long-term debt = current portion 682,638 + noncurrent 5,545,228 = 6,227,866 thousand = $6,227,866,000 (statement in thousands; converted to whole dollars). Commercial paper 20,456 thousand = $20,456,000 reported separately as short-term interim financing (6,227,866 + 20,456 = 6,248,322, agreeing with the MD&A's $6,248 million total debt). Bonds, notes and lease components are not shown separately in the campus document, so those component fields are null.
reporting_entity: UCLA campus including the UCLA Medical Center/hospital system, as carved out by UCLA management from the University of California system statements (unaudited). Debt is issued by The Regents.
caveats: UNAUDITED campus-level carve-out, not an audited statement. The document says debt is 'recorded and maintained centrally by UCOP on behalf of all campuses' and that UCLA 'has applied reasonable estimation methodologies to allocate such balances'; FY2023 comparatives were restated for methodology changes including a $399M bond-liability adjustment. The posted PDF's metadata shows it was generated on 2026-04-04, so this is a later (revised) edition of the 2023-24 report. The caption 'long-term debt' is not broken down; in the audited system statements the same caption includes lease liabilities and subscription (SBITA) liabilities as well as revenue bonds and other borrowings, so this figure is probably broader than the IPEDS-parallel definition (bonds + notes + finance leases) and cannot be narrowed from the campus document. Figure includes the medical center. The audited system statements (PwC, November 18, 2024) give no campus allocation. Confidence low for these reasons.

document_title: UC San Diego Detailed Financial Schedules for Fiscal Year 2024 (23/24 Unaudited Financial Schedules), Office of the Controller
page: 14 (Statement of Net Position, printed p. 13); 42-44 (debt recorded at the San Diego campus and summary, printed pp. 41-43); 45-49 (debt recorded at UCOP, printed pp. 44-48); 3 (Controller's letter)
quote: Statement of Net Position, Campus 2024 (in thousands of dollars): 'Current portion of long-term debt 430,500'; 'Long Term Debt 5,736,403'. Schedule of the San Diego campus long term debt recorded at the San Diego campus, Outstanding June 30, 2024: 'Total Capital Lease Obligations 30,196'; 'Finance Lease ROU Obligations 167,513'; 'Subscription liability/SBITA 40,133'; 'Total Revenue Bonds 1,224,213'; 'Total Central Bank Loans 1,933,551'; Third Party Debt 53,694; 'San Diego Campus $3,449,300'. Recorded at UCOP: 'Total Mortgages and Other Borrowings 152,747'; 'Total Revenue Bonds 2,564,856'; 'Total Long Term Debt Recorded at the Office of the President $2,717,603'. Summary: 'Total Long Term Debt $6,166,903'. Controller's letter: 'The Detailed Financial Schedules are not audited and are intended for internal use.'
arithmetic: All amounts in thousands, converted to whole dollars. Bonds = 1,224,213 (recorded at campus) + 2,564,856 (recorded at UCOP) = 3,789,069. Notes/loans = Central Bank Loans 1,933,551 + Third Party Debt 53,694 + Mortgages and Other Borrowings 152,747 = 2,139,992. Finance leases = Capital Lease Obligations 30,196 + Finance Lease ROU Obligations 167,513 = 197,709. Total = 3,789,069 + 2,139,992 + 197,709 = 6,126,770 thousand = $6,126,770,000. Excluded per brief: Subscription liability/SBITA 40,133. Check: 6,126,770 + 40,133 = 6,166,903 = 'Total Long Term Debt', which equals statement of net position current 430,500 + noncurrent 5,736,403.
reporting_entity: UC San Diego campus including the UC San Diego medical center (schedule lists medical-center bonds and leases), per unaudited campus schedules prepared by the UC San Diego Controller. Debt is issued by The Regents; part is recorded on campus books and part at the UC Office of the President (UCOP).
caveats: UNAUDITED campus schedule derived from the system's accounts; the Controller's letter (dated February 11, 2025) says the schedules 'are not audited and are intended for internal use' and that the University of California is audited on a consolidated basis by PricewaterhouseCoopers. Classification judgments made here: (1) 'Central Bank Loans' ($1,933,551 thousand) are internal loans from the UC system to the campus and are placed under notes/loans; (2) 'Mortgages and Other Borrowings' recorded at UCOP ($152,747 thousand) consists of project lines prefixed 'CP' and may be commercial-paper interim financing rather than long-term notes - the schedule does not say; (3) 'Finance Lease ROU Obligations' are GASB 87 lease liabilities (GASB has no operating/finance split for lessees) and are included as finance leases because the document labels them so; (4) SBITA of $40,133 thousand excluded. If the campus's own all-in caption is preferred, 'Total Long Term Debt' is $6,166,903,000. Unamortized bond premium treatment is not stated. Figure includes the medical center. Confidence medium: read directly from an official campus document that ties to its own statement of net position, but unaudited.

System-wide context only: CU Foundation endowment net assets $1,986,863,144 + University-owned custodial endowments managed by the Foundation $258,302,711 = $2,245,165,855, which is the Foundation's own printed 'total managed endowments' for all four CU campuses and system administration.

document_title: Missouri State University, A Component Unit of the State of Missouri - Independent Auditor's Report and Financial Statements, June 30, 2024 and 2023; Missouri State University Foundation - Independent Auditor's Report and Consolidated Financial Statements, June 30, 2024
page: University report: 14-15 (statements of net position), 48 (Note 15), 54 (Foundation endowment composition). Foundation report: 5 (statement of financial position), 14 (Note 5)
quote: University statements of net position, University 2024: 'Due from Foundation $6,199,762'; net position 'Restricted for Nonexpendable Scholarships and fellowships 6,199,762'. Note 15: 'In 1982, the University's Board of Governors authorized the transfer of its endowment fund of $199,762 to the Foundation for management purposes... In 2023, the University received grants of $6,000,000 from the Department of Education to establish endowment funds. The University's Board of Governors authorized the transfer of these funds to the Foundation for management purposes.' Foundation Note 5, composition of net assets by type of endowment fund at June 30, 2024: 'Donor-restricted endowment funds $116,814,419'; 'Board-designated endowment funds 3,256,393'; 'Total endowment funds $120,070,812'. Foundation statement of financial position: 'Funds managed for Missouri State University 6,199,762' (liability).
arithmetic: Institution-owned endowment (held and managed by the Foundation, carried by the University as 'Due from Foundation') $6,199,762 + Foundation total endowment funds $120,070,812 = $126,270,574. The sum is ours; neither document prints a combined total. Amounts are in whole dollars as printed.
reporting_entity: Missouri State University (Springfield and West Plains campuses and other locations, one audited entity) and its discretely presented component unit, the Missouri State University Foundation.
caveats: The University holds no endowment investments itself: its $6,199,762 of endowment principal is managed by the Foundation and shown at original amounts, with all investment earnings recorded in the Foundation's books (Note 15). The Foundation reports the same $6,199,762 as a liability ('Funds managed for Missouri State University'), so it is not part of the Foundation's net assets; the notes do not say whether accumulated earnings on those funds sit inside the Foundation's $120,070,812 endowment net assets, so a small overlap cannot be ruled out and the Foundation-only figure ($120,070,812) is the firmer number. The audited entity covers the West Plains campus as well as Springfield (IPEDS reports them as separate units). The University report on the web is a March 2025 re-posting (file name 'Revised0325'; PDF modified 2025-03-11) with the auditor's report still dated December 5, 2024; it notes an immaterial revision to the 2023 Note 17 disclosure only. Foundation report URL: https://www.missouristate.edu/FinancialServices/_Files/MSU_Foundation_2024_Audit_Report.pdf. Confidence medium for the combined total (possible overlap, and it is an addition across two entities); high for each component as printed.
